title: Milab abductee meets a Nordic on a military base: 'by degrees'

tellings.quote: she asked the Nordic if they were involved with the grace and the reply of the Nordic was by degrees.

plain: A researcher, Tim Alberino, retells a story from a book called Taken by the abduction researcher Karla Turner. In it, a woman who says she was taken by the military, not only by aliens, met a "Nordic", a tall, human-looking being, on a military base, and asked whether the Nordics were involved with the Greys, the small grey beings of many abduction stories. According to the story, the Nordic replied "by degrees", which would mean the different beings, and maybe the military, work together in some way.
